caption:
₹50,000 TV: how much of it is GST?

Since 22 Sep 2025, TVs above 32 inches carry 18% GST, down from 28%.
On an illustrative ₹50,000 bill (GST included), ₹7,627 is GST.
At the old 28%, the same pre-tax price would have come to ₹54,237, or ₹4,237 more.
How much of the cut a shop passed on varies, so check the GST line on your invoice.
